latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Optimistic Offline Lock Implementer skill.

- Guides users in implementing the Optimistic Offline Lock concurrency pattern end-to-end.
- Covers schema changes (version column), version-conditioned SQL, ORM-native annotation/config, and full version round-tripping.
- Specifies implementation steps for collision detection, handling ConcurrencyException, and designing proper collision UX (merge, force-save, abandon).
- Includes integration with Unit of Work commit sequence and rollback logic.
- Audits for anti-patterns and produces a complete implementation plan with checklist and test plan.
- Stack and ORM agnostic; designed for multi-request editing workflows in relational databases.
